name: Westbound Panama Canal "Master Chef" Serrano Ham Bruschetta & Exotic Melon Fruit Cup
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Westbound Panama Canal (Master Chef / Captain's Gala)
whyItWorks: Dry-cured Serrano ham on white toast and ripe honeydew/cantaloupe/mango cubes provide a light, dairy-free starter on long Panama Canal nights.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the Serrano ham and toasted bread (scraping off chopped olive tapenade if flaring) or select the ripe melon and mango pieces from the fruit cup.
watchOuts: Avoid seeded kiwi or passionfruit if included in the exotic fruit cup
Skip chopped olives on the bruschetta if flaring
